_comment: Does a tool from an MCP server reach the agent? The run adds profileRows to a copy of the test profile: the harness's dsh-mcp-client composing test/fixtures/mcp-fixture.mjs (a stdio server with one tool, vault_lookup), as a deployment composes any MCP server (docs/setup.md, MCP servers). The answer alone proves nothing: without the row, the agent found the fixture on disk, ran it by hand and gave the code. So the step also requires a call of mcp__fixture__vault_lookup, which only the composed server provides.

steps.say: deepbot fixture vault 에서 aurora 라는 코드 워드에 저장된 코드를 찾아서 알려줘.
